name: OCEN Integration Settings
description: This site's connection to the standalone OCEN site (ADR 0005) — the mirror image of OCEN Settings' los_site_url/integration_shared_secret fields on the other side. Used by los_engine.api.ocen_integration.submit_to_ocen() to hand a Loan Application to OCEN, and to authenticate inbound calls from OCEN (receive_ocen_stage_update/receive_ocen_offer). Shared-secret auth, not Frappe's User api_key/api_secret — see utils/shared_auth.py's docstring for why.

fields.label: OCEN Site Base URL
fields.description: e.g. http://localhost:8002 or the OCEN site's real base URL.

fields.label: Integration Shared Secret
fields.description: Must match OCEN Settings.integration_shared_secret on the OCEN site exactly. Sent/checked via the X-Integration-Secret header in both directions.
